instruction: From references.docx, collect DBLP BibTeX entries for the listed papers (published versions), and save them to 'references.bib' ensuring entries from EMNLP and NeurIPS conferences are included.

metadata.explanation: Checks for papers from EMNLP and NeurIPS venues. Verified: Spider(EMNLP 2018), CoSQL(EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019), Attention(NeurIPS 2017), GPT-3(NeurIPS 2020).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts venue information from BibTeX booktitle and journal fields
Metric uses appropriate fuzzy substring matching for venue comparison (handles variations like 'EMNLP 2018', 'Proceedings of EMNLP')
Both getter and metric properly normalize venues to lowercase for case-insensitive comparison
Expected values are semantically correct (EMNLP and NeurIPS are verified venues from the referenced papers per metadata)
Regex patterns correctly handle BibTeX nested brace syntax
Partial credit logic is sound (returns proportion of required venues found)
Edge cases handled appropriately (empty file returns empty list leading to 0.0 score)
Evaluator correctly verifies the key requirement: EMNLP and NeurIPS conference entries are present in the BibTeX file
